This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. The grievance of the Petitioner, in this writ petition, is with regard to the inaction of the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Lower Indra Irrigation Project, Khariar (Opposite Party No.3), in disposing of the application filed by her under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for brevity, "the Act") in terms of the award dated 02.04.2024 passed by the learned Civil Judge (Senior Division), Nuapada in LAR No.32 of 2019, in a reference under Section-18 of the Act.

3. It is submitted by Mr. Das, learned Counsel for the Petitioner that pursuant to judgment dated 02.04.2024 passed by the learned Civil Judge (Senior Division), Nuapada, in LAR No.32 of 2019,
the Petitioner filed an application under Section 28-A of the Act as his land was also acquired under the self-same notification.
The said application was kept pending and was not disposed of.

Hence,
this writ petition has been filed.

4. This Court taking into consideration the grievance of the Petitioner vide order dated 09.12.2025,
directed learned State Counsel to take instruction in the matter.

5. Mr. Biswal, learned Additional Standing Counsel, on instruction, submits that the application filed by the Petitioner under Section 28-A of the Act could not be disposed of, as the order of sanction in respect of LAR No.32 of 2019 was pending with the Water Resources Department,

sentences.text:
1 Government of Odisha.
6.
He however, placed on record a copy of the Letter No.583 dated 20th March 2026 issued by the Special Land Acquisition Officer stating that sanction in LAR No.32 of 2019 has already been received.
In the said letter, it has also been stated that the application of the Petitioner shall be taken up serially, as huge application under the same provision is pending before him.

7. Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case and submissions of learned Counsel for the parties, this Court, without expressing any opinion on the merit of the application filed by the Petitioner under Section 28-A of the Act, disposes of the writ application with a direction to the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Lower Indra Irrigation Project, Khariar (Opposite Party No.3) to dispose of the application filed by the Petitioner as expeditiously as possible, preferably by end of June 2026, giving opportunity of hearing to the Petitioner.

If the Petitioner is found eligible to receive compensation in terms of LAR No.32 of 2019, then the Special Land Acquisition Officer shall do well to re-determine the same and release the compensation by end of September, 2026 with proper acknowledgment.
8. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
(K.R. Mohapatra) Judge (S.K. Mishra) Judge Banita Signed by: BANITA PRIYADARSHINI PALEI
